collection.description: A keeper records a stretch of unusually vigorous swimming near an Orange Snooper, tied in stories to the Magic Fish of Health.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A keeper records a stretch of unusually vigorous swimming near an Orange Snooper, a fish associated in island stories with the Magic Fish of Health. Some call it magic, others point to water, food, chance, or observation error.

text_only.reason: the legend's name; nobody's health changes
explanations offered; no food is gained or lost

b.name: Answer B
b.text: The keeper controls feeding and water changes; results are suggestive but not decisive.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: The magician reports a meaningful sensation; a skeptical apprentice records only what can be measured.

d.name: Answer D
d.text: The animal thrives or fades according to ordinary conditions; its mystery remains unresolved.

a__fx.name: Answer A
a__fx.text: A small ceremony comforts the keeper and draws attention to the fish, without proving causation.
